title: PlanFence：面向分布式LLM智能体记忆的依赖范围验证协议
summary: PlanFence 解决分布式LLM智能体团队中的“过期计划执行”问题：即使状态新鲜，计划也可能失效。该协议要求计划引用所用公共记录，执行器仅验证影响待执行外部操作的记录，必要时重新规划或阻塞。实验显示，在30个受控工作流中，PlanFence 避免了所有无效操作，而仅检查新鲜度的执行器全部失败。
summary_en: PlanFence addresses stale-plan execution in distributed LLM-agent teams, where fresh state doesn't guarantee plan validity. It validates only dependency-scoped records before actions, replanning or blocking as needed. In 30 controlled workflows, PlanFence avoided all invalid actions, unlike freshness-only executors which failed every task.
